content_units: A crowd-friendly mix of comedy, adventure, and mystery that stays   PG-13 or lower  , under   2h 20m  , avoids heavy gore, and lands with a satisfying or upbeat finish. At least   5 of these   are solid picks for ages   11–13  .
Film   Year   Rating   Runtime   Best Fit   Why it works
Knives Out   2019   PG-13   130 min   Mystery/comedy   Clever whodunit, funny ensemble, tense but not gruesome, very engaging for a group
Enola Holmes   2020   PG-13   123 min   Adventure/mystery   Fast-paced, witty, light detective story with a warm tone
National Treasure   2004   PG   131 min   Adventure   Treasure-hunt energy, easy crowd-pleaser, low intensity violence
Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle   2017   PG-13   119 min   Comedy/adventure   Big laughs, accessible action, upbeat and easy to watch in a group
The Princess Bride   1987   PG   98 min   Adventure/comedy   Charming, funny, quotable, and one of the safest all-ages picks here
Clue   1985   PG   94 min   Comedy/mystery   Silly murder-mystery farce; the tone stays playful rather than dark
Paddington 2   2017   PG   104 min   Family comedy/adventure   Warm, hilarious, visually delightful, excellent for ages 11–13
Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse   2018   PG   117 min   Adventure/comedy   Stylish, funny, energetic, and emotionally uplifting without being bleak
Option 1:   Best overall group pick — Knives Out     Sharp mystery with broad appeal for teens and adults     Most balanced
Option 2:   Most 11–13 friendly — Paddington 2     Funny, warm, and easy for everyone to enjoy     Safest all-ages pick
Option 3:   Most energetic — Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle     Big comedy beats and adventure momentum     Best for a lively night
Option 4:   Most classic fun — The Princess Bride     Light adventure, romance, comedy, and endlessly quotable lines     Best nostalgic pick
